_note: Index of bundled game profiles, matched on the ROM file's CRC32 (from RetroArch GET_STATUS) rather than its internal header, so a hack is told apart from its base game and from other hacks. A profile describes where a ROM keeps its data; the app reads that data live, so adding a game costs a few KB. See docs/game-profiles.md. defaultProfileId is used when no crc32 matches.

profiles._note: 4B3D4957 confirmed live 2026-08-04 as the crc32 RetroArch actually reports for a v2.1.1.1 Unbound ROM -- differs from the originally-registered 483D4957 (likely a different patch/build), which is kept in case that version is also still in circulation. A profile that doesn't match the loaded ROM's crc32 is treated as unrecognized and falls back to generic CFRU discovery, which got species/stats/item right by luck for this ROM but produced garbled ability names -- the fix is making sure the real crc32 is registered, not a code change.
